title: Te Fiti 6x6 (Nurikabe Chaos Construction)
author: MaizeGator
rules:
This puzzle is part of the puzzle pack
Chaotic Construction
by the Sudoku Skunkworks.

It is also an easier, 6x6 version of a 9x9 puzzle with the same
ruleset that I will publish soon.

Rules:

Chaos Construction:
Divide the grid into regions of 6 orthogonally connected cells each,
such that every cell belongs to exactly one region. Place the digits
1 to 6 exactly once in each row, column, and region.

Nurikabe:
Divide the grid into an ocean and several islands. The ocean must
be orthogonally connected and cannot contain a 2-by-2 area.
Islands must be orthogonally connected and cannot touch each
other along edges. Each island contains exactly one clued cell,
whose digit indicates the size of the island. If a number is
given in the corner of a clued cell, the digits on that island
must sum to that number.

Region Connectivity:
Within each region, ocean cells and island cells must each
form an orthogonally connected component.
